entities.summary: Parannoul is a pseudonymous South Korean shoegaze musician. He has released four solo albums: Let's Walk on the Path of a Blue Cat (2020), To See the Next Part of the Dream (2021), After the Magic (2023) and Sky Hundred (2024).
